name: ten_towns
title: Ten Towns
description: Frontier towns that dealt in [[scrimshaw]] from the great lakes of [[Maer Dualdon]] and [[Lac Dinneshere]]. The Ten-Towns were: [[Dougan's Hole]], [[Good Mead]], [[Easthaven]], [[Caer-Dineval]], [[Caer-Konig]], [[Lonelywood]], [[Bremen]], [[Termalaine]], [[Targos]], and [[Bryn Shander]].
